episodes.title: The Nest
episodes.summary: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they're invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

episodes.title: Deep Trouble
episodes.summary: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

episodes.title: Boo to You
episodes.summary: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke
episodes.summary: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

episodes.title: Heavy Metal
episodes.summary: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

episodes.title: Iced Out
episodes.summary: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

episodes.title: Sick Day
episodes.summary: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

episodes.title: Bad Egg
episodes.summary: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

episodes.title: Home Alone
episodes.summary: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

episodes.title: Slobber Power
episodes.summary: Cutter gets a chance to be a "mom" when a newly hatched dragon bonds with him, and they'll both be needed to get the others out of a tangled mess.

episodes.title: Crash Course
episodes.summary: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

episodes.title: Furious Fun
episodes.summary: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

episodes.title: Grumblegard Part 1
episodes.summary: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

episodes.title: Grumblegard Part 2
episodes.summary: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

episodes.title: Double Finked
episodes.summary: Magnus's nephew, Axel, arrives on the island and tells the Rescue Riders that he wants to join their team. But is he just a trickster like his uncle?

episodes.title: Divewings
episodes.summary: When sea-dwelling dragons called Divewings start attacking ships near the island, the Rescue Riders have to find out what's making them so upset.

episodes.title: Mecha-Menace
episodes.summary: Magnus and Axel unveil their new "mechano-dragon." It's impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove it's no better than a bucket of bolts.

episodes.title: Summer Holiday
episodes.summary: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isn't quite what they hoped for.

episodes.title: Treasure Riders
episodes.summary: When a swashbuckling adventurer named Waldondo comes to town, the Riders enthusiastically join him on a treasure hunt for a priceless gem.

episodes.title: Puff Enuf
episodes.summary: The Riders find a Puffertail and train her to join the family. She struggles to learn but soon finds herself with a chance to make a big rescue.

episodes.title: Hot, Hot, Hot
episodes.summary: Aggro is embarrassed about big changes she's going through. And when she gets stuck in a volcano, the Rescue Riders seek help from ... Magnus?

episodes.title: High Anxiety
episodes.summary: When a mama Ironclaw dragon gets caught high on a mountain with a broken wing, Hannahr the blacksmith has to confront her fear of heights to help out.

episodes.title: King Burple
episodes.summary: After Burple and Cutter crash-land in a village of tiny dragons, Burple's unintentional act of courage leads the locals to crown him as their king.

episodes.title: Charged Up
episodes.summary: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

episodes.title: Belly Flop
episodes.summary: The Riders have to save Elbone when he's swallowed by a giant Sea Gronckle, and Dak's awful cooking might be just the thing to do it.

episodes.title: Game of Horns
episodes.summary: At a big town festival, Magnus challenges Duggard in a competition to be chief of Huttsgalor! Can the Riders help their friend keep his helmet?
